BiblicalUsage: The word appears once, when Abraham built the altar, laid the wood in order, and bound Isaac his son and laid him on the altar upon the wood. It is the binding itself, the tying that makes the offering complete.
TheologicalSignificance: Isaac let himself be bound, and the ram took his place, and that is the whole gospel in one picture.
